topic: Handling the second call on a busy office line
hook_options: Your office phone rings. Line one is talking. Line two starts blinking.
A busy signal loses just as many plumbing jobs as an unanswered phone.
We keep hearing this from office managers: three calls hit at once every morning.
What happens when two homeowners call your shop at the exact same minute?
Two calls ring at the exact same second. Your office can only pick up one.
tweets: Your office phone rings. Line one is talking. Line two starts blinking.

Your office manager is on the phone booking a main line clear. She can't just hang up. Line two rolls to voicemail. The caller doesn't leave a message. They just hang up and call the next shop on their phone.
